oligoglycerol detergent (OGD) architecture enables control of protein purification and preserves interactions with native membrane lipid during purification.

the oligoglycerol detergent family offers the ability to fine-tune the detergent architecture for specific applications in membrane protein purification, structural biology and membrane protein-lipid interactions.
we introduce a novel family of detergents that enable the purification and characterization of membrane proteins and that we show how these detergents can be fine-tuned for individual applications.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and application of new detergents for the investigation of protein–membrane interactions.
the investigation of the structural biology and biochemistry of membrane proteins.
the development of novel detergents for the purification and structural investigation of membrane proteins, in particular, GPCR.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
OGDs are a new family of detergents with a unique modular design and a broad range of applications in membrane protein biology.
OGDs enable the purification of bacterial membrane proteins and a functional G-proteins-coupled receptor (GPCR) and preserve their interaction with native membrane lipides.
the OGD family represents a significant advance in detergent design.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
OGDs are an exciting new family of detergents that enable the purification of a broad range of membrane proteins and the preservation of interactions with membrane lipids.

we have developed a family of detergents with modular architecture and have used native MS to demonstrate that these detergents preserve the interactions of membrane proteins and native membrane lipids.

we developed a family of oligoglyceryl detergents (ODGs) that enable the purification and structural characterization of G-protein coupled membrane receptors and their interactions with membrane lipids.
The main takeaway from our work is that
OGDs enable the structural analysis of membrane protein–lipid complexes.
OGDs are modular detergents that enable fine-tuning of the properties of detergents and thus the investigation of membrane protein-lipid interactions.
